rust_summary: a server game rule was set (`native_game_rule_changed`).
doc_summary: `native_game_rule_changed(rule, value)`, once the server set a game rule (`GameRules.set` with a server): `/gamerule`, the game rules screen, the management protocol, a test environment or `server.properties`. `rule` is the rule's id (`minecraft:keep_inventory`), `value` its new `GameRuleValue`. Before `world_game_rule_change`. Server-side. Bundles need "hooks": @API:game_rule_changed@.
